title: Kitchen Letter Mix
hook: Safe hands know which tools belong with grown-ups.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat with utensil sounds muted
visualStyle: warm 3D preschool kitchen storybook, colorful safe utensils and foods, rounded forms, clean countertop composition

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child sorting kitchen objects by safe-use category
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: risk cue -> recall gap -> target -> point-only or safe empty-hand gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a muted tabletop woodblock tap and marimba shape-note after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a muted tabletop woodblock tap and marimba shape-note after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Kitchen Letter Mix into a kitchen risk map: cold, room-temperature, powered, hot and sharp objects are sorted before any pretend action.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads tool category and hazard boundary first, then food/shape; real sharp, hot and powered tools stay adult-only.
